source: The owner's Coach Mode spec, coach/SPEC.md section 4 (CD-004). The stops are the order the owner runs a first series of client sessions in; the questions are the owner's own plain words for each stop.
confidenceNote: A coaching convention, not a sourced figure: no number in this file is money or a rate. Edit it without code; coach/engines/session.js evaluates each stop's doneWhen from the household, never from a typed answer.
note: stops holds every stop once; a path is an ordered list of stop ids. Each stop: fields (ids in data/fields.json, one entry box each; 'list:debt', 'list:asset', 'list:goal' is the whole list), figures (read-outs the stop shows; their unit is in readouts here, their words in data/help.json), questions (each one item), doneWhen (tests coach/engines/session.js knows, all must pass), doneLabel (what done means, in words). rail is always shown.

life.title: The big picture
life.covers: What they want, when, and the big dates coming: a wedding, a move, a kid, a change of job.

questions.text: If money worked out, what would the next ten years look like?
What big dates are coming: a wedding, a move, a baby, a new job?
What do you spend on that you never regret?

income.title: Money coming in
income.covers: Every way money comes in, what lands in the bank, and whether it swings.

questions.text: Every way money comes in, even small or now and then?
What lands in your account each payday?
How different is a good month from a bad one?

income.doneLabel: We know what lands each month, even roughly.

spending.title: Money going out
spending.covers: Home, food, getting around, everything else, and what is left.

questions.text: Walk me through a normal month: rent, food, getting around.
Where does money go that you wish it did not?

spending.doneLabel: We know what is left at the end of a normal month.

debt.title: What you owe
debt.covers: Every debt: what is owed, the rate, the smallest payment, and when they are gone.

questions.text: Every debt: cards, car, student loans, anything owed to family?
Which one keeps you up at night? That one can go first, even if it is not the priciest.

debt.doneLabel: Every debt is listed and the debt-free date shows.

safety.title: The cushion
safety.covers: Cash in the bank, and the insurance that protects the rest.

questions.text: If pay stopped tomorrow, how long could you go?
Who depends on your money, and what insurance do you get through work?

safety.doneLabel: We know how many months the cushion covers, and what is missing.

assets.title: What you own
assets.covers: Every account with money in it, and the match at work.

questions.text: Every account with money in it, and roughly what is in each?
Does your employer match, and are you getting all of it?
Do you know what your retirement funds charge?

assets.doneLabel: We can see the whole picture: owned minus owed.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.covers: How they file, where they live, and one easy tax win.

questions.text: How did you file last year, and did you get money back or owe?
Do you think your tax rate will be higher now, or later in life?

taxes.doneLabel: We know the tax on the next dollar, and one move to try.

goals.title: Goals and the map
goals.covers: A price and a date on each goal, and what each needs a month.

questions.text: What would each goal cost, roughly, and by when?
If not everything fits, which goal moves first?

goals.doneLabel: Every goal has a monthly number and a status.

decisions.title: Big decisions
decisions.covers: The big choices this year: a house, a car, a job, a move. Each gets a verdict.

questions.text: Which decision is on your mind this year?
Knowing what it costs: go, wait, or no?
